notes: Adds orbital MRI; modality outside typical ophthalmic imaging.

name: uveitis_smote

name: amd_dme_3d_oct

citation: Huang W, Qin L, Xu M, et al. Comprehensive 3D Optical Coherence Tomography Dataset for AMD and DME: Facilitating Deep-Learning-Based 3D Segmentation. Scientific Data. 2026;13:224. doi:10.1038/s41597-025-06497-1
notes: The release contains 122 AMD and 102 DME volumes. Of these, 104 volumes are labeled (62 AMD and 42 DME) and 120 are unlabeled.

name: as_oct_keratitis

citation: Sun Y, et al., 'An AS-OCT image dataset for deep learning-enabled segmentation and 3D reconstruction for keratitis', Scientific Data 2024.
